description: This file manages post-build operations for a runtime environment, including copying static assets, generating runtime aliases, and orchestrating build steps.

methods.name: listStaticExtensionAssetOutputs
methods.description: Returns a sorted list of destination paths for static extension assets.

methods.name: copyStaticExtensionAssets
methods.description: Copies static extension assets from source to destination paths, creating directories as needed.

methods.name: writeStableRootRuntimeAliases
methods.description: Generates alias files in the dist directory for runtime scripts matching a specific pattern.

methods.name: runRuntimePostBuild
methods.description: Executes the sequence of post-build steps including copying assets and generating aliases.
